rule: GOAL: Align the plug's prongs with the socket contacts. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plug; Space rotated it clockwise. RULE: Prongs must point right to slide into the socket. TRAP: Assuming any rotation worked; the prongs had to face the socket's opening.

GOAL: Guide the falling block into the yellow cup. CONTROLS: Arrows move the platform; space drops the block. RULE: The block must land directly inside the cup's notch, not on the rim or floor. TRAP: Landing on the platform does not count as a win; the block must fall through the gap into the cup.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single surviving peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the empty space where it will land after jumping. RULE: A peg moves by jumping directly over an adjacent neighbor into the empty spot immediately beyond it. TRAP: Assuming any adjacent empty space is a valid landing spot, ignoring the strict requirement to jump over a piece.

GOAL: Place all three rings into the highlighted bar. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and pick up or drop rings. RULE: The bar fills only when three rings occupy its three distinct cells. TRAP: Assuming the player standing on a cell counts as filling it.

ESTABLISHED: The crate stops at the right panel's edge, likely satisfying that side. White is at the right panel. The left socket is empty. FAILED: Pushing the crate right did not complete the level. GOAL IS NOT: Filling only the right socket. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move White. White pushes the crate in the direction of movement.

GOAL: Move the white token into the right hole and the dark token into the left hole. CONTROLS: Click dark centers to swap token faces; click light centers for nothing; use arrows to move the player token. RULE: Only clicking the dark center triggers a swap, letting you switch which token you control. TRAP: Clicking the white center does nothing, so waiting for a reaction there wastes time.

GOAL: Move the cart so its peg sits directly next to the box's peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a valid spot to move it. RULE: Pegs do not auto-merge; they only connect when physically adjacent on the grid. TRAP: Assuming adjacency triggers a win; you must manually position them side-by-side.

GOAL: Slide the green piece left then down to clear the path. CONTROLS: Click to select, arrows to move. RULE: Moving the green piece first reveals the hidden yellow piece. TRAP: Moving the yellow piece first blocks the green piece's exit.

ESTABLISHED: The block exits platforms based on momentum direction, not the nearest edge. FAILED: Dropping the block through the right side of the blue platform causes it to deflect right into the red, hitting the ceiling. GOAL IS NOT: Simply dropping the block straight down; it requires precise horizontal deflection off the red platform’s left side to reach the notch. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected platform. SPACE releases the block.

GOAL: Place rings in specific spots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move or rotate; Space grabs or releases rings. RULE: Rings stay attached to your side until you drop them. TRAP: Moving into a ring rotates you instead of pushing it.

ESTABLISHED: The board contains four sockets and four tokens, all initially empty and unplaced. FAILED: Moving the light token to the left socket alone does not trigger a win, nor does partial placement of other tokens. GOAL IS NOT: Simply parking the light token in the leftmost slot is insufficient for completion. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the active token until it hits a wall or obstacle; selecting a different token changes the active piece.

ESTABLISHED: Carts act as landing sockets adjacent to boxes. Pegs cannot enter boxes directly but can jump into adjacent carts. Carts carry pegs along pipes to other box sockets for capture. FAILED: Assuming pegs enter boxes directly. Assuming carts are static obstacles. Trying to move pegs into empty box cells. GOAL IS NOT: To move pegs into the box cells themselves. To use carts as permanent blockers. CONTROLS: Jumping pegs land in adjacent carts. Carts transport pegs to other sockets.

ESTABLISHED: Piece C is mated to A and B at two separate junctions, but the A-B junction is filled with charcoal instead of gray. FAILED: Assuming A and B share a connector at the expected third coordinate, which results in a collision rather than a mate. GOAL IS NOT: A simple three-way hub where all pieces meet at one point; the geometry requires distinct pairwise contacts. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move pieces; rotation keys change orientation. Watch for charcoal overlaps indicating invalid placements.

GOAL: Gather scattered rings and deliver them to the container. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character and push carried rings; Space releases the held ring. RULE: The automated helper retrieves rings only when you are occupied with other tasks or after a delay. TRAP: Assuming the helper acts instantly; it often idles until you complete your current move sequence.

GOAL: Assemble three scattered shapes into a single connected structure. CONTROLS: Click to select a piece, Space to rotate it, Arrow keys to slide it. RULE: Pieces only lock when their specific connector tabs align perfectly with matching slots. TRAP: Assuming pieces could be rotated while already touching another piece, causing invalid moves.

GOAL: Guide four scattered pieces into matching slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece; clicks select a piece to make it active. RULE: Only the selected piece responds to arrow keys, leaving others stationary until chosen. TRAP: Assuming all pieces move together wastes time; you must constantly click to switch which piece you are steering.

GOAL: Clear the board by moving pegs into the cart to clear obstacles and capture ghosts. CONTROLS: Click pegs to jump, use arrow keys to move carts, and click ghosts to capture them. RULE: Pegs capture ghosts only if landed on directly, while carts clear path blockers for jumps. TRAP: Assuming carts are static; ignoring that moving carts can block jumps or create new capture spots.

GOAL: Move a walker to guide a sliding block into its matching socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the walker to push adjacent blocks or navigate empty space. RULE: Blocks slide until they hit a wall or another block, locking into place. TRAP: Assuming you can push a block while standing directly behind it; you must stand beside it to move it sideways.

ESTABLISHED: Black cells are passable for helpers, as proven by a delivery through a black diagonal. Five rings are delivered. The sixth is being carried by a helper near the bottom, which has a short path to the final empty socket. FAILED: Attempts to manually move the trapped player failed. Over-analyzing connectivity without observing helper movement wasted time. GOAL IS NOT: Escaping the enclosure or manually placing rings on sockets. CONTROLS: Placing rings on wall cells triggers helpers to pick them up and deliver them to sockets.

ESTABLISHED: The top bar shows one white unit and thirty-one charcoal units. This ratio remains unchanged after fifty-three actions, proving the bar is not a simple action counter. FAILED: Moving pieces north, south, east, and west; rotating pieces; and clicking did not change the bar or clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Filling the top bar completely, as level three completed with the bar partially filled. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move pieces; spacebar rotates; clicking interacts. None affected the top bar during testing.

GOAL: Guide the walker to push the plus shape into its matching socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the walker; clicks interact with objects. RULE: Pieces slide a fixed distance when pushed, stopping at walls or alignment points. TRAP: Believing rims block movement wastes time; only the fixed slide distance and floor boundaries matter.

GOAL: Remove the piston from the shaft to clear the exit path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the walker; pushing up against obstacles tests their solidity. RULE: The piston is a spring-loaded trap that violently ejects the walker downward when pressed. TRAP: Assuming the piston was a solid wall or pushable block instead of a dynamic hazard.

GOAL: Move rings to matching sockets by guiding helpers through the maze. CONTROLS: Arrows move you; helpers automatically follow to grab and deliver nearby rings. RULE: Helpers walk over filled sockets, allowing them to navigate through completed areas to reach new tasks. TRAP: Believing you must manually position helpers. They move autonomously; your job is only to clear their path.

ESTABLISHED: The immobile peg at the bottom of the central box cannot be captured, as no valid jump lands there. FAILED: Attempts to reduce the peg count to one have failed because the immobile peg remains permanently on the board. GOAL IS NOT: Reducing the total number of pegs to one. CONTROLS: Clicking empty space or invalid targets does nothing; only valid jumps remove pegs.

GOAL: Capture two pegs by moving the cart and jumping the rider over them. CONTROLS: Click to jump or board. Arrow keys move the cart. RULE: Riders jump over pegs to capture them; carts can only move when empty. TRAP: Moving the cart while the rider is aboard blocks progress. Ensure the rider is dismounted before shifting the cart.

GOAL: Arrange three platforms to block the rising fluid and guide it into all three upper notches without any leaks. CONTROLS: Click a platform to select it, press the right arrow key twice to shift the selected platform two columns to the right, then press space to run the simulation. RULE: Fluid always rises vertically until blocked, then flows horizontally to the nearest available opening before continuing upward. TRAP: Assuming platforms remain selected after moving them; clicking a new platform deselects the previous one, wasting actions if you forget to re-click.

GOAL: Rotate pieces to align all matching tabs into closed pairs. CONTROLS: Click a piece to select it, then press Space to rotate it in place. RULE: A piece is solved when every exposed tab connects to a compatible tab on another piece. TRAP: Assuming rotation moves a piece; it only spins around its anchor point, so position must be correct first.

ESTABLISHED: The walker can bypass the bumper via columns 60-62. Pushing the block left twice moves it to columns 21-26, enabling a launch to the upper-left room. FAILED: Direct pushes from the starting position are blocked by the bumper. Previous long-path attempts exceeded the move budget. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving the block to the center. The block must reach the upper-left room via the launch pad. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the walker. Pressing into the block pushes it. Launch pads move the walker vertically when activated.

ESTABLISHED: The cart can reach the top box via the rail network, potentially accessing (3,11). One capture is already complete. FAILED: Assuming the cart cannot reach the upper rails or that (3,12) is permanently immobile. GOAL IS NOT: Simply making one capture, nor leaving all pegs on a single line. CONTROLS: Cart moves along rails. Pegs jump over adjacent pieces to land in empty cells, capturing the jumped piece.

ESTABLISHED: The right 24-wide block belongs at the bottom-right; the blue 24-wide block belongs at the top-right. The 20-wide block is correctly placed and needs no movement. FAILED: Moving the right 24-wide block eight steps right, and assigning the blue block to the top-left corner, both failed. GOAL IS NOT: Placing blocks in their initial horizontal columns or keeping the 20-wide block in its starting vertical band. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected platform one step. Mouse clicks select platforms. Spacebar submits the level.

GOAL: Arrange four floating platforms to perfectly plug the gaps in the bottom wall. CONTROLS: Click a platform to select it, arrow keys to shift its position, and Space to confirm the layout. RULE: Platforms must sit at specific heights to align with the wall notches without overlapping each other. TRAP: Assuming platforms could pass through each other; they block movement, so you must move the highest or furthest platform first to clear the path.

ESTABLISHED: Rings trail behind you when carried. The action key releases the held ring into the cell immediately behind your current position. FAILED: Grabbing rings from non-adjacent cells or misaligning before pickup results in empty-handed movement and wasted turns. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the ring's location; precise alignment and facing direction are strictly required for interaction. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. The action key picks up adjacent rings or drops carried rings directly behind the player.

GOAL: Channel fluid into four cups without leaking. CONTROLS: Click a platform, then press Left or Right to slide it. Space releases the flow. RULE: Platforms must touch to form a continuous surface; gaps let fluid fall through. TRAP: Assuming a long bar is one piece. It was two separate platforms; sliding one left closed the gap, sealing the leak.

GOAL: Assemble the vine and three socks by rotating and sliding pieces to mate their tabs without overlapping. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide pieces; Space rotates the selected piece; mouse clicks select a piece. RULE: A piece mates when its body aligns with the vine and its tabs fit exactly into the vine’s gaps. TRAP: Assuming rotation keeps the piece’s origin fixed; it actually shifts the bounding box, causing misalignment.

GOAL: Guide two pegs into the target box using a moving cart. CONTROLS: Click a peg to project a ghost path; click again to move it along rails. RULE: A peg only moves if its projected path lands directly on the cart’s current position. TRAP: Assuming pegs move independently; they are blocked unless the cart is precisely aligned to catch them.

ESTABLISHED: Spout fluid rises, hits Row 9, spreads left to the bracket, and stops. FAILED: Placing the long piece at Row 6 leaks fluid up Column 7 and past Row 2. GOAL IS NOT: Filling the bottom-left pocket by blocking the left spread alone. CONTROLS: Fluid moves up, spreads horizontally, and stops at walls or occupied spaces.

ESTABLISHED: The pieces interlock by mating tabs. The total area is fifty-four cells. FAILED: Overlapping placements and unmatched tabs. GOAL IS NOT: Filling the board completely. CONTROLS: Rotate pieces to match tab counts and shapes.

GOAL: Guide the walker to the hole by moving through the tube into the upper room. CONTROLS: Arrows move the walker; standing in the tube while pressing UP triggers the transfer. RULE: You must wait in the tube until the cycle completes to move up. TRAP: Pressing UP without being aligned in the tube does nothing, wasting time.

ESTABLISHED: A single green peg remains. The red peg survives green jumps in previous tests. The cart resets cargo when leaving the screen. The goal cell is likely the nub at 7,2. FAILED: Driving the cart off-world to drop cargo. Jumping vertically over the red. Assuming the red is invincible. GOAL IS NOT: Getting the red peg to the target cell. CONTROLS: Click to select a piece. Click a destination to move or jump. Jumping removes the jumped-over piece if capturable.

ESTABLISHED: The walker moves exactly three spaces per press; blocked moves waste the press. The green piece requires a charged piston beam to transfer upward. FAILED: The direct straight-line route from the start to the socket is blocked by obstacles. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing the walker to the exit; the green piece must also reach the socket. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected piece three spaces. Mouse clicks select pieces.

GOAL: You carried rings to specific sockets to complete a circuit. CONTROLS: Arrows moved your character and dragged the attached ring. Space dropped the ring into a slot. RULE: The ring always trails directly behind you, occupying the square you just left. TRAP: Assuming you could drop a ring while moving. You must stop, drop, then move away to clear the path.

GOAL: Move the red peg to create a capture path. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a target square to hop. RULE: Pegs can hop over adjacent pieces to land on empty squares. TRAP: Assuming the cart blocks movement; the red peg rode the cart and could still move independently.

GOAL: Carry a floating ring to a matching socket and drop it in place. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move and push crates; Space attaches or drops rings. RULE: Rings float freely and cannot be pushed by walking into them. TRAP: Trying to shove a ring like a crate wastes turns; you must face it and press Space to pick it up first.

ESTABLISHED: The cart is currently loaded with the red peg, blocking the green peg's hop destination. Landing on a cart only works if it is empty. FAILED: Selecting the green peg yields no valid move highlights because the required landing spot is occupied by the loaded cart. GOAL IS NOT: The puzzle does not require the green peg to hop onto the currently loaded cart. CONTROLS: Clicking a cart selects it or may trigger unloading actions, distinct from selecting empty cells or pegs.

GOAL: Fill the vertical socket with two rings using limited moves. CONTROLS: Arrows push or carry rings; Space detaches or installs them. RULE: Only the top ring of a stack can be moved or placed. TRAP: Assuming you can slide a bottom ring out while one is on top.

ESTABLISHED: Blocked moves set facing direction. Detaching requires facing the ring. Carrying a ring moves it relative to you. FAILED: Assuming blocked moves do not update facing. GOAL IS NOT: A simple pathfinding task. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move and set facing. Space detaches if facing a ring, or places if carrying.
